connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.2.15: rollback to the 0.2.13 streams route (HLS via literal-selection) on owner request - the 0.2.14 variant-gated experiment is withdrawn. Behavior identical to 0.2.13: streams play; per-title audio follows the dub flag; no sub/dub candidate filtering.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
